format: Single Bakery, prototype 1,600 to 1,800 sq ft (leased), including lease costs but not real estate purchase

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Nothing Bundt Cakes® Bakery that is 1,600 sq. ft. to 1,800 sq. ft. in size is $ $475,200 to $994,100. ... This includes $71,784 to $76,784 that must be paid to the franchisor and its affiliate.

fee.quote: You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $45,000 when you sign a Franchise Agreement (the “Franchise Fee”).
fee.note: No veteran discount printed. Development Rights Rider: $45,000 for the first Bakery plus 50% ($22,500) of the fee for each additional Bakery upfront, balance at signing. Also payable to franchisor/affiliate before opening: $10,000 Opening Advertising Program (up to $5,000 more), about $16,034 of initial purchases from NBC Distribution, $750 Master Architect Program fee.

royalty.quote: Royalty 6% of Bakery’s weekly Net Revenues Due on Tuesday of each week on Net Revenues during previous week ending Sunday

adFund.quote: Combined contributions made by you for the Production Fund and the Paid Media Fund will be 5% of your weekly Net Revenues (see Note 3)
adFund.note: 5% combined (Marketing Production Fund + Paid Media Fund), split set by franchisor. Local Cooperative contributions, if designated, are credited toward the Production Fund contribution.

item19.note: Part I covers 545 franchised Bakeries open at least 24 months (average age 7.4 years); none excluded; affiliate-owned excluded. 4-Wall EBITDA (Part III, 358 Bakeries) is after royalty and marketing fees adjusted to 11% of Net Revenues, but excludes owner salary/draw (190 Bakeries reported owner payroll averaging $80,457), depreciation, amortization, interest, taxes, accounting and consulting fees. 409 Bakeries excluded from Part III (incomplete P&L or >10% discrepancy, under 24 months, or Hub locations).

special: Required purchases of cake mixes, ingredients, accessories and supplies from the franchisor's affiliate NBC Distribution (about $16,034 before opening, then ongoing). The 4-Wall EBITDA excludes owner payroll, which averaged $80,457 among the 190 Bakeries that reported it. 117 transfers (resales) in 2025.
issues: Item 19 says 765 franchised Bakeries at FYE 2025 vs 771 in Item 20 Table 1. Part II square-footage table labels its averages 'Avg 2024 Net Revenues' although the section covers the 2025 Fiscal Year. Part III text says exclusions for incomplete 2024 P&Ls (167+222+18 = 407, not 409). Cover sentence contains a doubled '$ $'. Vintage and density tables are in thousands of dollars.
